name: citation-zero-and-three-digit-out-of-range
description: Two evidence items before dedup and no markers: the range is 1..2. [0] is always out of range, [2] is in range, [100] (three digits, the most the pattern takes) is above 2: fires on [0] and [100], with offsets after the check-mark emoji (one UTF-16 code unit, U+2705).
